name: two observations
test:
out = impute_and_standardize([[2.0],[6.0]])
assert len(out) == 2 and all(len(row) == 1 for row in out)
assert abs(out[0][0] + 1) < 1e-5 and abs(out[1][0] - 1) < 1e-5

name: imputation uses observed mean
test:
out = impute_and_standardize([[1.0],[0.0],[5.0]])
assert len(out) == 3 and abs(out[0][0] + 1.224744871) < 1e-5
assert abs(out[1][0]) < 1e-5 and abs(out[2][0] - 1.224744871) < 1e-5

name: multiple missing values
test:
out = impute_and_standardize([[1.0],[0.0],[0.0],[5.0]])
assert len(out) == 4 and abs(out[0][0] + 1.414213562) < 1e-5
assert abs(out[1][0]) < 1e-5 and abs(out[2][0]) < 1e-5
assert abs(out[3][0] - 1.414213562) < 1e-5

name: different missing patterns by column
test:
matrix = [[1.0,2.0,0.0],[0.0,1.0,1.0],[5.0,6.0,5.0]]
out = impute_and_standardize(matrix)
assert len(out) == 3 and all(len(row) == 3 for row in out)
assert abs(out[1][0]) < 1e-5 and abs(out[0][2]) < 1e-5
assert out[0][0] < out[1][0] < out[2][0]
assert out[1][1] < out[0][1] < out[2][1]

name: completed-column population moments
test:
matrix = [[1.0,0.0],[0.0,2.0],[4.0,8.0],[7.0,0.0]]
out = impute_and_standardize(matrix)
assert len(out) == 4 and all(len(row) == 2 for row in out)
for j in range(2):
    col = [row[j] for row in out]
    assert abs(sum(col) / 4) < 1e-5
    assert abs(sum(x*x for x in col) / 4 - 1.0) < 1e-5

name: input remains unchanged
test:
matrix = [[1.0,0.0],[0.0,2.0],[5.0,8.0]]
before = [row[:] for row in matrix]
out = impute_and_standardize(matrix)
assert matrix == before and out is not matrix
assert all(a is not b for a,b in zip(out,matrix))
